items.notes: ACL ownership note covers mapping ownership and single-point risk, but not the unowned-mapping failure mode; supporting.
Modernization options excerpt has no local read-model, synchronous dependency, or strong-consistency content; hard negative.
HTTP safety/idempotency distinction does not address recovering a submitted job's status after a lost acknowledgment; hard negative.
States Envoy fetches cluster endpoints from a xDS management server; this names the infrastructure required.
States split needs a known total count or an explicit release/expiry rule recording a partial result; directly answers.
Claim-check decision requires payload lifecycle and failure-handling owners, but does not state the early-token failure; supporting.
Outbox records publication intent locally and uses a relay; excerpt covers the commit-before-publication gap that the relay closes.
Explicitly notes a relay may send a message more than once, which is why duplicate publication must be tolerated.
Eviction versus refresh distinction shows stale reads during async refresh, but does not frame expiration alone as the freshness failure; supporting.
Describes write-path cache invalidation and its stale window; implies a reliable change signal but does not state the dependency; supporting.
